title: Unlock the first two robots: the mark-1 once the player has farmed enough by hand, the mark-2 once a mark-1 has been used
tier_reason: S-12 landed the top two rungs (bench, Mark III) on a ladder whose bottom two, ruled on 2026-09-04 under Q-88, were never built: today the mark-1 and the mark-2 are plain purchases with nothing but price between them, so a player can buy a reacting machine before ever using a pre-programmed one.
first_action: Run the two greps above, read only the lines they point at plus 30 around each, then write the gate.
ask:
Do NOT start by reading tests/test_runner.gd; it is 15,000 lines and three attempts spent their whole budget in it. This item is the sim rule only, in one file, with one test.

Rule: the shop offers the mark-1 robot only once the player has farmed a full day (the sim's day counter is at least 1 and at least one harvest has been recorded), and offers the mark-2 only once a mark-1 has completed one round. Where: systems/sim/sim_world.gd — find the shop stock function with `grep -n "shop\|stock\|bot_mk1\|bot_mk2" systems/sim/sim_world.gd` and gate the two entries there; the day counter and harvest count are fields on SimWorld (grep for `day` and `harvest` in that file's `var` lines). Test: append ONE function `test_robot_shop_unlocks()` to tests/test_runner.gd using tools/merge_appended_scenario.py's convention (append at the end, register the call at the top in _init beside the other test_ calls); assert the shelf before and after each condition via SimWorld.apply_action with the shop verb the other shop tests use — copy the staging lines from the nearest existing shop test, found with `grep -n "func test_.*shop" tests/test_runner.gd`. Run `godot --headless --path . --script res://tests/test_runner.gd` and report the PASSED/FAILED line. Write the rule into docs/DECISION_LOG.md under P-13's entry as one sentence with today's date.
source_message: Filed by the chief of staff from Tomas's S-12 report, 2026-09-10.

amendments.what: brief rewritten after the card was parked for cost
